preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is an integer between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(s) == int(len(s)) and 2 <= len(s) <= 100 for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]])
preconditions.description: Each test case string s has length between 2 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(s.count('(') == 1 and s.count(')') == 1 for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]])
preconditions.description: Each test case string s contains exactly one '(' and exactly one ')' character.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '()?' for c in s) for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]])
preconditions.description: Each test case string s consists only of characters '(', ')', and '?'.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' if any(all((balance := balance + 1 if c == '(' else balance - 1 if c == ')' else 0) >= 0 and (balance := balance + 1 if c == '(' else balance - 1 if c == ')' else 0) == 0 for c in s) for s in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:t+1]] for replacement in product('()', repeat=s.count('?'))) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: For each test case, output 'YES' if there exists a way to replace all '?' with either '(' or ')' such that the resulting sequence is a regular bracket sequence (RBS), otherwise output 'NO'. A sequence is RBS if it can be balanced with a non-negative balance at every step and zero balance at the end.
